recent_en: N2N Connect reported a 49% year-on-year rise in net profit to RM2.62 million for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 despite lower revenue. It also declared a first interim dividend of 1 sen per share and changed its financial year end. Substantial shareholder Quah Choon Wah filed multiple changes in shareholding between September and November.
notable_en: Declared a first interim dividend of 1 sen per share, with ex-date on 4 December 2026.
Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with net profit up 49% year-on-year to RM2.62 million.
risks_en: Substantial shareholder Quah Choon Wah filed multiple changes in shareholding between September and November 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM21.72 million, up 5.1% quarter-on-quarter but down 16.3% year-on-year; net profit was RM0.85 million, down 70.2% quarter-on-quarter and 81.7% year-on-year; net margin was 3.9% versus 13.8% in the previous quarter.
